Question: Assalam o ailekum, My Native place in Ambur ( 200 kms from Chennai ) but i am doing a job in chennai... every weekend i visit my native ( Ambur ), i stay in our own house in chennai... In this case which place do i need to perform qasar...... Answer ID: 10938 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 234/234=M/1430) If you have permanent job in Chennai and you have bought or built house in Chennai to live there permanently and if you have begun to live constantly in Chennai with all belongings, then in this case both the places (Ambur and Chennai) are your watan asli , you will pray full salah at both the places. If the case is otherwise, then submit the question again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
